_comment: Stage 1.2 OPSD, paper main setting: eta = 0.5 (per rank and update 3 on-policy streaming contexts + 3 teacher-cache contexts, 8 ranks), 300 student updates (the paper reports the S300 EMA student: students/step_00000300/ema; the lr is constant after the 20-step warm-up). Needs the teacher cache (configs/stage1_2_opsd/teacher_cache.json) as OPSD_TEACHER_CACHE=<cache run>/learner/cache. Paper hardware: 8x AMD MI355X (about 8 h).
